data.name: Excav: Night Shift
data.detailed_description:
You are a freelance investigative journalist following a string of unnerving reports: employees of Excav—a private research and excavation company—have been disappearing, failing to show up for work with no explanations, no calls, and no bodies.
Your journey begins on a lonely forest roadside, leading you into the isolated security outpost overlooking the dig. The lights are still on. The office still functioning. But the staff… are gone.

The site was abandoned only hours before your arrival. And something is still roaming the halls.

A Slow-Burning Descent Into the Unknown

As you investigate the empty facility, the truth behind the excavation begins to surface. Strange audio logs hint at rising paranoia. Security robots continue their patrols without orders. A cheerful rabbit-themed animatronic stalks the shadows. And deep within the facility drifts something far older — a floating skull entity tied to the core mystery of the dig.

Every step pushes you deeper into a puzzle of corporate secrecy, missing workers, and a discovery that should never have been unearthed.

Features

🕯 Atmospheric First-Person Horror
Explore a tense, slow-burn environment where silence is as threatening as what hunts you.

👁 Blinking Mechanic
A dynamic blinking system adds pressure, vulnerability, and timing to encounters.

🎧 Fully Voiced Tapes
Uncover the final days of the excavation site through voice logs left behind by workers, security staff, and researchers.

🤖 Non-Human Threats
Stealth through patrol paths of malfunctioning security robots, evade a menacing rabbit animatronic, and survive encounters with a supernatural floating skull.

🧩 Puzzles & Investigation
Solve environmental puzzles, decode security systems, and uncover the truth behind the abandoned dig site.

🏃 Stealth and Fast-Paced Escapes
Stay hidden… or run. Some threats can’t be reasoned with.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-7400 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / GTX 960 / AMD RX 460 (2–4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 / Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
